title: Project instructions a model actually follows
summary: Write a short, checkable instructions file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and the like) that a coding model reads at the start of every session.

title: Documentation as a prompt
summary: Write READMEs and specs that a model or a new teammate can act on without asking a single question.

title: Skills: packaging a repeatable task
summary: Package a task you repeat into a skill folder with a SKILL.md file, so a model loads it only when the task comes up.

title: MCP, part one: giving a model tools
summary: Learn what the Model Context Protocol is, how a client talks to a server, and what to check before you trust one.

title: MCP, part two: defining tools well
summary: Define MCP tools a model can choose and call correctly, with clear names, useful descriptions, strict input schemas and errors it can recover from.

title: Agent workflows: one coordinator, scoped workers
summary: Split a job between a coordinator and scoped workers, write briefs they can act on alone, and plan the job so no two workers collide.

title: Loops and graphs
summary: Run a model in a loop against a test with a fixed exit and a cap, and plan a job as a graph so you know what can run at once and what sets the finish time.

title: Self-research and verification
summary: Get a model to check its own claims, by finding sources before stating facts, proving things once with real output, naming what it did not verify, and cross-checking with a fresh second pass.
